blocks.title: Scale reaction heat
blocks.problem: A balanced equation consumes 2 mol of X and has $\Delta H=-164$ kJ as written. Find the heat for 0.750 mol X.

steps.title: Convert extent
steps.md: The reaction runs $0.750/2=0.375$ times per mole of the written reaction.
steps.why: The coefficient 2 defines the reference amount.

steps.title: Scale
steps.why: Heat at constant pressure scales with the reaction extent.
